panels.html:
Pandal Photography Tips

Night Lighting & Angles

More

Prime Golden Hours: Capture pandal exteriors between 1:00 AM and 4:00 AM when crowds thin out and LED light gates shine brightly.

Camera Exposure: Set ISO between 800–1600 and aperture f/2.8 to capture intricate clay idol details under warm sanctuary lighting.

Drone Regulations: Drones are strictly banned over pandal grounds and major crowd corridors without Kolkata Police permission.

Pandal Etiquette & Customs

Respectful Pilgrim Rules

More

Shoe Counter Norms: Remove footwear before stepping onto sanctum platforms during Pushpanjali or Aarati offerings.

Pushpanjali Dress Code: Ethnic wear (saree, kurta dhoti, or smart traditional attire) is preferred during morning flower offerings.

VIP / Senior Citizen Entry: Look for marked "Senior Citizen & Differently Abled" queue gates at major pandals for quick entry.
